tone_policy: fixed source common exposure, plus scalar gain limited [.95,1.05] and channel mean offset limited +/-.008 linear RGB; no texture-RMS normalization or texture smoothing
blend_policy: regular lattice; raised edge linear overlap blend on prior similar texels only; same-world texels are never modified; at most four ordered contributors per texel
teacher_policy: only remaining eligible unknown, narrow quilting seams or low-frequency tone boundaries; exclude every trusted same-world texel; preserve majority of source2 as unmasked real-reference texture anchors
traceability: mixture_tile_id/weight provides all blended contributors. Every tile references a source bank crop; that crop retains per-texel original Brown UV and source plane/world transform. Primary UV map represents the dominant contributor, not the sole contributor in blends.
numerical_anchor_semantics: immutable accepted parent field; its source1/2/3 provenance is inherited, not relabelled as new same-world real photographs
new_region_source_kind: similar-photograph texture inference conditioned on the accepted parent boundary, including any inherited teacher colour conditioning
